subject: Proposal: short-term micro-sustainer credits while procurement completes
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Malik <sarah.malik@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: short-term micro-sustainer credits while procurement completes

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — I really appreciate the context on Acuity's integration timeline. I understand procurement is doing an internal review and that the PO route is likely to take another 7–12 business days. We don't want your engineers to lose momentum.

To keep the pilot (and your data flow tests) running, we'd like to offer a short-term micro-sustainer credit package:
- 5,000 token-equivalent credits valid for 14 days
- Can be applied to the existing sandbox project and will preserve current model and routing settings
- No invoice required; this is a one-time goodwill grant contingent on re-confirmation when the PO clears

If that sounds helpful I can loop in our Finance and CS teams to get the codes issued today. I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines next steps we recommend while procurement finalizes the PO.

Quick asks: can you confirm (a) the expected PO date window, and (b) whether legal needs a redline to the SOW? That'll help us avoid surprises when we transition to the paid contract.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Sarah Malik <sarah.malik@acuityhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Acuity Health Procurement <procurement@acuityhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: short-term micro-sustainer credits while procurement completes

Mateo — thanks for the clear options and for the MAP. I shared both with our procurement and legal teams this morning. Quick update: procurement has placed the PO into a finance review queue due to year-end vendor consolidation; they estimate 10 business days. Legal is asking for a brief statement of work (SOW) with the pilot acceptance criteria spelled out before they sign — should be quick but adds 3–5 business days.

Yes, a 14-day 5k-credit top-up would be tremendously helpful so our engineers can finish the EHR adapter tests. Please go ahead and issue the codes. Procurement@acuityhealth.com is included here — they may follow up on the SOW specifics.

Appreciate your flexibility.

—Sarah
Sarah Malik
Director of Product, Integrations | Acuity Health
sarah.malik@acuityhealth.com

Folks — Acuity (DEAL-2027-045) is asking for a 14-day 5k token top-up while procurement/legal finish the PO + SOW. Procurement estimate ~10 business days, legal 3–5 business days. Sarah confirmed the grant would be used immediately to complete EHR adapter tests.

Requested ask: approval to issue a one-time micro-sustainer voucher (5,000 tokens / 14 days). Risks are minimal; we should tie the grant to the existing sandbox project and require confirmation when PO arrives.

If approved I'll generate the voucher codes and send to Sarah & procurement. I attached the MAP I shared with them for context.

Thanks —
Mateo

- Add a brief expiration and reconciliation clause in the voucher metadata so Finance can track it against DEAL-2027-045.

Camila — tagging you to handle issuance (voucher file + codes). Once issued, Mateo, please confirm the code and copy Finance (finance-credits@redwood.inference.com) so they can reconcile.
